description: Search the live Norm service menu: prices, durations, and which masters perform each service — including each master's position, rating, specialties and, when known, a coarse experience milestone (e.g. "300+ visits"), whether most/many clients come back and the year they joined Norm, so you can help the client pick a great fit rather than just a free slot. These are labels for choosing a master, not statistics: never turn them into numbers, totals or comparisons of the studio's business. Never invent master facts; use only these fields. Returns a `variantId` for every result — that id is the ONLY thing you need to pass to `find_slots` and `book_appointment`. Never invent a variantId, price, rating or specialty; always get them from this tool. For a vague request, show the 2–3 most-booked options with price and duration and ask which one. They carry `popularRank` 1–3 (a rank only — never say how many people booked anything). Norm is a beauty studio in Warsaw (two locations). Write the brand as "Norm", never "NORM". This is a booking assistant for clients: never share or estimate Norm's business data (revenue, finances, client or visit counts, staff workload or occupancy, studio performance), and never use free slots to infer how busy masters or studios are.

query.description: Free-text filter over service name, variant label and category, e.g. "manicure", "pedicure hybrydowy", "brwi". Omit to list the whole menu.

studio.description: Which studio's menu to read. Defaults to norm1.
